description: How to chain AINumbers tools into audited workflows: call with NO recipe_id for the compact recipe index, or with one recipe_id for that workflow's full step-by-step recipe. Every recipe carries the suite conventions end to end: Policy Mandate exports, execution_hash verification, and receipts.

recipe_id.description: A recipe id from the no-arg index (e.g. "aml-programme"). Omit for the compact index; pass exactly ONE id per call.
